 On October 26, 2026, Beşiktaş hosts Istanbul Başakşehir in the Turkish Super Lig, with This Istanbul derby features a high-scoring team facing an opponent whose season has been inconsistent. TelecomAsia offers a free prediction for the Beşiktaş vs Istanbul Başakşehir match, along with key statistics.
 Receive Your Welcome Bonus Beşiktaş
 The Black Eagles are playing an open style of football. In their last six matches, they have rarely kept a clean sheet: 2-2 against Kristal Palace, 2-3 away to Hoffenheim, 2-1 against Kocaelispor, and 4-1 against Olympique Marseille. Their European campaign is noticeably more vibrant than their domestic one.
 In the league, the picture is less rosy. Beşiktaş lost 0-2 at home to Trabzonspor, creating almost no chances in that match, and in September, they fell 2-3 to Amedspor. For a team that beats opponents of Marseille's caliber in the Europa League, this is a significant dissonance.
 The main feature of Beşiktaş this autumn is that their attack is functioning better than their defense: they have scored at least twice in five of their last six matches and conceded in five of those six. For betting, this profile is more interesting than dry statistics.

 The visitors arrive unbeaten in their last three official matches. Başakşehir defeated Gaziantep 2-1, and prior to that, they played to a 0-0 draw in Konya — the first match in a long time where the team did not score.
 The attacking potential is there, and it is not just theoretical: in September, Başakşehir thrashed Gençlerbirliği 4-0. However, that same month also saw a collapse — a 0-5 defeat to Amedspor, the team's heaviest result of the season.
 The pattern of their play is unstable: Başakşehir can score four goals or none at all. Away from home, the team plays more cautiously, but against Beşiktaş, they usually cannot sit back — the hosts apply pressure from the first minute.
 Head-to-Head Statistics: Beşiktaş vs Istanbul Başakşehir
 The last six encounters have been evenly split: two wins and two draws for each side. The February meeting ended 3-2 in favor of Beşiktaş, while the previous year, the hosts won 2-1, and in the spring of 2025, they lost 0-2. In three of the six encounters, both teams scored.

 Matches involving Beşiktaş rarely end with fewer than two goals: the odds for over 2.5 goals are 1.40. 
 If the hosts draw, there is a total of over 3 — betting is available at odds of 1.60. 
 A -1.5 handicap on Beşiktaş is priced at 1.95 and seems logical for those expecting a confident victory. 
 Bookmaker Odds for Beşiktaş vs Istanbul Başakşehir
 The hosts are the clear favorites: Beşiktaş's victory is priced at 1.36, a draw at 5.20, and an away win for the visitors at 7.30. Such a disparity is rare in the Turkish championship and indicates not only class but also the home factor.
 Further down the line, the odds are more interesting. Both teams to score is offered at 1.63, over 2.5 goals is priced at 1.40, and under 2.5 goals is at 2.77. A -1.5 handicap on the hosts is available at 1.95, while the double chance for the visitors is at 3.05. The line anticipates goals, and there are few reasons to deviate from this logic.
 Prediction for Beşiktaş vs Istanbul Başakşehir on October 26
 The class difference is evident, but betting on a large victory for the hosts is risky. Beşiktaş wins this season but rarely does so without conceding: even in their thrashing of Marseille, they allowed a goal, and against Kocaelispor, they only managed a 2-1 win.
 Başakşehir arrives in good form: three matches unbeaten and no goals conceded in Konya indicate that the visitors know how to maintain structure. However, against hosts who constantly pressure the penalty area, this structure usually holds for just one half.
 Thus, the logic behind the main bet: goals from both sides are more likely than a large scoreline in one direction. Beşiktaş has conceded in five consecutive matches, while Başakşehir has already scored four in a game this season. We expect a high-scoring match where the hosts will ultimately take all three points.
 Beşiktaş scores a lot and concedes almost every match, while Başakşehir can retaliate in attack even away from home. The main prediction is both teams to score, with the hosts winning as a secondary bet.
